idea-plugin.name: ERB Escape Audit
idea-plugin.description:
15 rules that find every line in a Rails .erb view where output escaping was switched off or was the wrong escaping.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → ERB Escape Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/erb-escape-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/erb-escape-audit

action.text: ERB Escape Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run ERB Escape Audit on the file in the editor
